description.value: The Other Liquor Store is a retail beer, wine, and spirits shop in Chilliwack operated by Springs Group, a BC-based chain of over 13 liquor stores and brew pubs. Staff hand-pick the selection and are available in-store to help customers discover new favourites. The store also offers delivery and curbside ordering for those who prefer not to stop in.
